display_name: Obstructive/Mixed Apnea Index: (Obstructive apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal +mixed apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep from type I polysomnography
calculation: 60*(oarbp +  oarop  + oanbp  + oanop + marbp + marop + manrbp + manrop)/slpprdp
